Metadata.CommitMsg:
Week 4: Kafka KRaft, protobuf contracts, outbox CDC, Kafka Streams, reward saga

- 3-broker KRaft Kafka (RF3, minISR 2), Kafka UI, Apicurio, Debezium Connect (streaming profile)
- Explicit topic design (scripts/kafka-topics.sh); protobuf Envelope contracts with
  BACKWARD_TRANSITIVE checks (scripts/register-schemas.sh)
- Non-blocking franz-go publisher with durable disk spool and replay; match events
  with deterministic IDs and rounds; account player IDs on /ws
- Transactional outbox (protobuf envelope) published by Debezium EventRouter
- Java Kafka Streams: idempotent leaderboard, session windows, EOS v2, IQ HTTP, DLQ
- Go reward saga: reserve/grant/compensate, retry topic, DLQ
- eventcat debug/replay tool; Experiment 004; ADRs 0009-0012
Metadata.Author: SanidhyaMadheshia <sanidhyamadheshia@gmail.com>

Misconfigurations.Title: Image user should not be 'root'
Misconfigurations.Description: Running containers with 'root' user can lead to a container escape situation. It is a best practice to run containers as non-root users, which can be done by adding a 'USER' statement to the Dockerfile.
Misconfigurations.Message: Specify at least 1 USER command in Dockerfile with non-root user as argument
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add 'USER <non root user name>' line to the Dockerfile
